sql:
SELECT P.ID, P.Birthday, L.Date, L.PLT
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', L.Date) = '1984'
AND julianday('now') - julianday(P.Birthday) < 50 * 365
AND L.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400
